vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security PRs skip the schedule and the release-age wait (Renovate forces minimumReleaseAge: null), so never automerge them. addLabels keeps the top-level "dependencies" label; labels would replace it.

packageRules.description: Renovate cannot do lockfile-only updates for bun, and the default range strategy (replace) skips every release inside a ^ range. Bump the package.json range so in-range patches and minors are proposed and bun.lock is regenerated with them.
Require dashboard approval before opening breaking major upgrade PRs.
Every patch update arrives in one weekly PR (renovate/patch-all). separateMinorPatch keeps a patch here even when the package also has a newer minor, which goes to the minor PR.

0.x patches can break, so they go to their own weekly PR (renovate/patch-all-0.x) for a person to merge. A branch automerges only when every upgrade in it does, so one 0.x patch in renovate/patch-all would hold every other patch.

npm patches on 1.x and later automerge once every check on the PR is green and the release is 3 days old. Repo-level GitHub auto-merge is off and main is unprotected, so Renovate merges the PR itself (platformAutomerge: false) after the CI workflow passes.
Every minor update arrives in one weekly PR (renovate/all-minor), merged by a person.
Keep Actions patch and minor bumps on one branch instead of splitting them.
Batch routine action bumps and digest pins into one weekly PR, merged by a person. Actions changes alter the CI gate itself, so they never automerge.
